question: Does a newly reconstructed circular-lag envelope-correlation family interact with calibration-only Personal Anchor on native EPN612 users?
historical_identity: No claim of equivalence to the unavailable historical RLCS implementation
family: ReconstructedRlcs: 25 ms RMS envelope, circular lags 1..4, correlation mean and standard deviation; eight channels, eight output features
target_split: Reuse exact whole-trial calibration/evaluation IDs from frozen feature_bank_epn_probability_{validation,final}_20260915 runs; calibration trials excluded entirely from scoring
source_classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced six-class LogisticRegression C=1, max_iter=1000, seed=20260915; 3-fold source-user OOF temperature; full source refit only after temperature selection
F0_provider: Frozen existing F0 state and source-user OOF temperature from feature_bank_epn_probability_{validation,final}_20260915; no F0 refit
personal_anchor: Mean standardized feature vector per class from target calibration trials only; local softmax temperature median of calibration self-distances; blend weight shots/(shots+2)
interaction: Joint minus RLCS-only minus Anchor-only plus F0 base, for macro-F1, negative log loss and negative Brier
primary_readout: Per-user and pooled trial-level four-arm scores and reconstructed-RLCS population-versus-personalized paired errors
final_interpretation: Exploratory confirmation because EPN users 19-21 have been examined by earlier project experiments; source and formula are frozen before this new run, but final users are not newly untouched
limits: No own-device, force, calendar-day, or exact historical-RLCS claim
